Behind the Scenes

Ugmuls 5.5e Automation v1.2.0 resources, installation, and compatibility.

Source and Downloads

  • GitHub repository
  • Releases and downloads

Install in Foundry

The module is not yet listed in Foundry’s package directory. Install it using its manifest URL:

  1. Open Foundry’s setup screen and select Add-on Modules → Install Module.
  2. Copy the manifest URL below and paste it into the Manifest URL field.
  3. Click Install and allow Foundry to install the module and its required dependencies.
  4. Launch your world, open Game Settings → Manage Modules, enable Ugmuls 5.5e Automation and its required dependencies, then save.
  5. Refresh all GM and player clients after installation or updates.

Foundry installation manifest ↗

https://github.com/Ugmul-dnd/ugmuls-5-5e-automation/releases/latest/download/module.json

Copy the link’s address rather than the JSON contents. This URL installs the latest published GitHub release.

Compatibility and integrations

Bonus-damage setup and compatibility. Automated damage riders such as Sneak Attack, Hex, and Hunter's Mark are based on the Foundry D&D 5.5e Player's Handbook items and activities. Automation may also work with characters imported from D&D Beyond, but those imports have not been tested.

Version 1.2.0 supports Foundry VTT 14, verified with 14.370, and D&D5e 6.1.0 or later (verified on 6.1.0). Automated Conditions 5e and Dice So Nice! are required.

PHB class updates target the official Player’s Handbook (2024) 3.0.0. Update the book, then review features already owned by your characters: book updates do not automatically replace those items. Official content is not included.
